name: lim
description: Less is more. Small Claude Code plugins that each do one job and prove it.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Review before you commit: checks first, a fresh reviewer labels findings P1 to P5, P1 and P2 are fixed and re-reviewed, and the rest is your call.

plugins.name: clear-explain
plugins.description: Explanations you read once and understand the same way: the answer first, one meaning per word, one idea per sentence, and technical terms in their official English names.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Prove features by running them: a feature map of commands and expected results, run by a script that decides pass or fail and saves the output as evidence.
